messages:
rea_pm: Quick sync — proposing the 'Launch Litmus' checklist for Private Deploy v1. Focused on VPC/on-prem packaging + upgrade paths + customer-managed networking. Short proposal below, please react or reply by EOD.

rea_pm: Core proposal: 1) Minimal installer (airgap + online), 2) Upgrade paths: patch-only + in-place major w/ operator fallback, 3) Networking: customer router handoff + IP preservation mode, 4) Rollout gates: canary tenants, rollback window, SLO smoke tests.

sam_eng: +1 on canary tenants. Question: do we require kube 1.25+? what about kubeproxy vs eBPF?

rea_pm: aim to support kube 1.22+ for patch lane, but canary operator features (major upgrades) will need 1.25+. We'll document supported matrix.

lin_field: Customers with strict netops want IP preservation across upgrades. How invasive is that for us?

sam_eng: IP preservation implies we can't change pod/network CNI ranges. We'll add a 'preserve-network' flag to installer and add step in upgrade operator to skip CIDR migrates.

anya_security: KMS/HSM integration is required for a few large customers. We should tighten the KM flow in the installer and expose key rotation docs. Also need audit log retention mention.

tj_sre: Rollback window: propose 24h for major upgrades, 72h for patch rollouts? Rollback UX needs to be automated: single-command revert + traffic switch.

emma_solutions: Installer offline story: provide a tarball + preflight script. Also include a 'network-handshake' checklist for customer NetOps to sign off (routes, BGP/peering, MTU).

sam_eng: For automatic fallbacks, runtime should support model variant routing, but for private deploy we need a simple config in operator to route to local fallback cluster.

deploy-bot: CI: private-deploy/installer: 12/13 tests passed (airgap image packaging flaky on SLES). See: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/12345

rea_pm: OK next steps: sam -> make installer PR w/ preserve-network flag; tj -> draft rollback playbook; emma -> network-handshake doc; anya -> KMS checklist. We'll reconvene Thu 11am. :thumbsup:
